name: GrooveSeek
summary: MCP server for hybrid semantic and full-text search over Markdown knowledge bases.
features: search Markdown knowledge base with hybrid search
generate embeddings for semantic vector search

usage_guide.open_hint: Run `groove serve --kb-path <your knowledge base folder>` and connect your MCP client to it.

features.feature: search Markdown knowledge base with hybrid search
features.title: Search a Markdown knowledge base with hybrid search
steps: Put your Markdown notes in a folder, such as <kb folder>.
Start the server with `groove serve --kb-path <kb folder>` and connect your MCP client.
Call the `search` tool with a query and a limit, for example {"query": "<your text>", "limit": 3}.

setup.command:
mkdir -p /tmp/kb && cat > /tmp/kb/intro.md <<'EOF'
---
title: Introduction
date: 2024-01-01
topic: general
depth: 1
tags: [intro, overview]
---

# Introduction

GrooveSeek is a knowledge base search system.

## Semantic Chunking

Semantic chunking splits documents into meaningful pieces based on headings.
It uses embeddings to find relevant content.

## Features

GrooveSeek supports hybrid search combining semantic and full-text search.
EOF
cat > /tmp/kb/advanced.md <<'EOF'
---
title: Advanced Guide
date: 2024-02-15
topic: advanced
depth: 2
tags: [search, hybrid]
---

# Advanced Guide

## Hybrid Search

Hybrid search combines vector similarity with keyword matching for better results.

## Embeddings

Embeddings are generated with FastEmbed using BGE models for semantic search.

## Live Sync

A file watcher keeps the index fresh when files change.
EOF

findings.summary: Panic and unbounded allocation (OOM) in the CFB/OLE2 parser on malformed input
rust-openssl has incorrect bounds assertion in aes key wrap
rust-openssl: rustMdCtxRef::digest_final() writes past caller buffer with no length check
rust-openssl: Unchecked callback length in PSK/cookie trampolines leaks adjacent memory to peer
rust-openssl: Deriver::derive and PkeyCtxRef::derive can overflow short buffers on OpenSSL 1.1.1
rust-openssl has undefined behavior in X509Ref::ocsp_responders for certificates with non-UTF-8 OCSP URLs
